exception_title: AP vs Reentry Permit Form Variant
exception_description: Single I-131 form used for advance parole and reentry permit; fee and validity period fields not branched by travel-doc type.
Emergency advance parole requested; no pending humanitarian or AOS basis verified before issuance.

exception_title: AP Validity Overlap with Prior AP
exception_description: New AP issued while prior AP still valid; overlap period creates ambiguity on which document governs reentry.

exception_title: Refugee vs Asylee Travel Doc Routing
exception_description: Asylee requests refugee travel document instead of asylee travel document; system routes to wrong production workflow.

exception_title: Reentry Permit for LPR Abroad >2 Years
exception_description: Reentry permit filed from abroad by LPR absent >2 years; abandonment presumption not triggered at intake.
Photo background slightly off-white; OCR background classifier rejects submission as non-compliant.
Applicant travels on AP; I-485 not yet approved; system does not verify AP was properly issued pre-departure.
LLM accepts self-reported humanitarian purpose without checking whether travel destination contradicts claim.
Advance parole document used by person other than named beneficiary; biometric check not performed at POE.
I-485 denied while AP in production; AP card still mailed; presents as valid travel document for denied applicant.
Refugee travel document expiry straddles fiscal year; renewal fee schedule change not applied mid-cycle.
Applicant has TECS border encounter record; AP issued without TECS clearance review.
LLM misidentifies military family member parole-in-place eligibility; routes to standard AP workflow.
NGO files bulk I-131 for 200 refugees; batch processing assigns sequential A-Numbers incorrectly due to off-by-one.

exception_title: AP Revocation Not Propagated to CBP
exception_description: AP revoked by USCIS; revocation not transmitted to CBP TECS; alien re-enters on revoked document.
